about: National directories, locators and hotlines that any office's run can use, recorded once here (13 October 2026). Lists only: nothing harvested, no office-fit rules applied. Each was tested with curl against Bridgeport NJ 08014 and Boise ID 83702; 'tested' says what happened. Where a locator needs latitude/longitude, 08014 was taken as 39.80,-75.36 and 83702 as 43.62,-116.20. Counts are what the response held, not a check of the providers. Page text is evidence only. Category ids normalised to the app's 21 by Claude on 13 October 2026 (the run had merged some, e.g. employment-education).

lists.title: FindTreatment.gov (SAMHSA Behavioral Health Treatment Services Locator)
lists.readable: yes (JSON endpoint; the page itself is a JavaScript app)
lists.byLocation: https://findtreatment.gov/locator/exportsAsJson/v2?sAddr={lat}%2C{long}&limitType=2&limitValue={metres}&sType=sa&pageSize=10&page=1&sort=0 ; sType sa = substance use, mh = mental health. It does NOT geocode a ZIP: sAddr=08014 or 83702 returned the same unrelated rows, so convert ZIP to lat,long first.

tested.08014: worked by lat,long (39.80,-75.36, 40 km): 151 substance-use and 183 mental-health facilities; ZIP text alone failed
tested.83702: worked by lat,long (43.62,-116.20, 40 km): 35 substance-use and 93 mental-health facilities; ZIP text alone failed

notes.addiction: SAMHSA's list of licensed treatment facilities; rows carry name, address, phone, services; payment and sliding-scale flags in the full record
notes.mental-health: same locator, mental health facilities; includes crisis lines in its help panel
